en-US.longDescription: A powerful and versatile desktop search utility built with Flutter. Magic Box is a floating search tool that allows users to quickly search and retrieve information using various plugins, providing an efficient way to access files, applications, and web content from a single interface.
en-US.name: MagicBox

zh-CN.longDescription: 一款使用 Flutter 构建的强大且多功能的桌面搜索工具。Magic Box 是一个浮动搜索工具，允许用户使用各 种插件快速搜索和检索信息，提供从单一界面访问文件、应用程序和网络内容的高效方式。
zh-CN.name: MagicBox
